them.zh: rea-video 与它的 skill 做的

steps.en: Have your agent install the CLI and skill, then hand it a reference video
steps.zh: 让 agent 装好命令行和 skill，再交给它一条参考视频

steps.en: Split shots, separate voice, music and effects, and measure each shot
steps.zh: 切镜头，分离人声、配乐和音效，逐镜测量

steps.en: The agent looks at low-confidence shots and merges its answers into the verdict
steps.zh: agent 看图复核低置信镜头，把答案并入结论
steps.code: rea-video review out/ref · rea-video apply-review out/ref

steps.en: Read report.html, then name the target model and what to swap
steps.zh: 看 report.html，说出要用的模型和要换的东西

steps.en: Pack generated shots into the fewest model calls and check the plan
steps.zh: 把要生成的镜头装进最少的模型调用，并检查方案

value.en: A per-shot verdict on how the video was made and a remake plan, without scrubbing frames by hand
value.zh: 不用逐帧手看，就知道每个镜头怎么做出来、怎么复刻
